apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: TenantSpec defines the desired state of a Tenant as described in spec section 9.2.

cellID.description:
CellID identifies which Cell this tenant's workloads run in.
ADR-0008: Phase 0 defaults to "cell-0" (single Cell).
Phase 1+ PlacementEngine assigns tenants to specific Cells.

displayName.description:
DisplayName is the human-readable name of the tenant.
SEC-011: Pattern constraint prevents injection of control characters or markup.

environments.description: Environments lists the environments available to this tenant.

items.description:
TenantEnvironmentEntry defines an environment reference within a Tenant spec.
ARCH-004: Renamed from EnvironmentSpec to resolve naming collision with EnvironmentCRSpec.

cluster.description: Cluster is the target cluster for this environment.

gitops.description: GitOps configures the tenant's GitOps repository.

branch.description: Branch is the branch used for GitOps (default: "main").

repoName.description: RepoName is the name of the GitOps repository in Gitea.

limits.description: Limits defines resource limits for the tenant.

maxBuildConcurrency.description: MaxBuildConcurrency is the maximum number of concurrent builds.

maxCPU.description: MaxCPU is the maximum CPU allowed across all tenant namespaces.

maxMemory.description: MaxMemory is the maximum memory allowed across all tenant namespaces.

maxStorage.description: MaxStorage is the maximum storage allowed across all tenant namespaces.

plan.description: Plan is the subscription tier: starter, growth, or enterprise.

maxEnvironments.description: MaxEnvironments is the maximum number of concurrent preview environments.

ttlHours.description: TTLHours is the default time-to-live for preview environments in hours.

status.description: TenantStatus defines the observed state of a Tenant.

conditions.description:
Conditions represent the latest available observations of the tenant's state.
Condition types: GitRepoReady, NamespacesReady, RBACReady, QuotaEnforced,
NetworkPolicyReady, BuildNamespaceReady.

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:
message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.
This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

gitopsRepo.description: GitOpsRepo is the URL of the provisioned GitOps repository.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the most recent generation observed by the controller.

phase.description: Phase represents the overall tenant lifecycle phase.

description:
Tenant is the Schema for the tenants API.
A Tenant represents a team/account in LoopZero, with its own namespaces,
RBAC, quotas, and GitOps repository.
